card.name: Generic noun after a proper name
card.fires_on: A common noun such as reflex, wave, block, list, tool or revolution that follows a name or letter label and completes a named term. Examples are Babinski reflex, P wave and Urabi revolution.

modes.label: Eponymous medical terms
modes.description: The noun reflex or wave comes right after a person's name or a letter label in a clinical sign.

modes.label: Other named things
modes.description: A noun like revolution, block, list or tool ends a proper-name phrase in general web text.
